title: Solo indie dev here — looking for casual testers to help me launch my retro Western arcade game (plus a $10 challenge during closed testing)
author: Tricky_Description_9
selftext:
Solo indie dev looking for casual testers for **Jack's Next Shot**, a fast-paced retro pixel-art Western target-shooting arcade game, so I can complete my Google Play closed test and launch.

Quick transparency note: I built the game myself and used AI only for the in-app payment integration since I had no prior Google Play Billing experience. Gameplay is built for short sessions: chain combos, trigger special plates (freeze, explosive, electric, starlight), and swap revolvers, hats, and outfits.

# 🏆 $10 Challenge (Enchanted Gun Only)

The **first player to hit 1,000,000 points** **during the closed test using** **only the Enchanted Gun** **wins** **$10 USD**.

**How to claim:** Record the full run reaching 1,000,000 points with only the Enchanted Gun and send the video to **braverisinc@gmail.com**.

# How to Access (Do This in Order)

Google Play closed testing checks group membership before allowing access. Use the **exact same Google account** on the group, the opt-in page, and your phone's Play Store:

1. **Join the Google Group:** [Click Here](https://groups.google.com/g/jacks-next-shot-testers)

2. **Accept the Web opt-in:** [Click Here](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.braverisinc.jacksnextshot)

3. **Install from Google Play:** [Click Here](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.braverisinc.jacksnextshot)

If you open the store link before joining the group or use a different Google account, Play Store will show the app as unavailable.

Any honest feedback on aim feel, pacing, or bugs helps a lot—thanks for giving it a spin!
